author: fenglin

voice.microphoneDefault: Host-local ASR. A separately configured recognition endpoint overrides the local default.
voice.standardPackage: Includes Mandarin Zipformer ASR. PrimeTTS weights and its ONNX Runtime Web CPU engine are optional local-mode assets.

verified.protocolAndClientFixture: Fixed origin and exact voice, key rotation, provider errors and PCM chunk forwarding. Short multi-sentence replies make one request. Per-call repeated reads of the same delivery do not generate again. Barge-in, hangup and iterator cancellation stop playback. Explicit prior providers remain selectable.
verified.credentialSmoke: An isolated credential store in the official rc.5 accepted and persisted a synthetic BREEZE_API_KEY for the owner. Masked description, rotation, unset and denial to unauthorized peers were checked.
verified.officialServiceCheck: Unauthenticated GET returned HTTP 401 AUTH_REQUIRED. The official public voice page and catalog identify this voice.

authenticatedSynthesis.format: raw signed PCM16 LE, 24 kHz mono
authenticatedSynthesis.timingBasis: Monotonic time from adapter invocation to first nonempty response-body chunk and response EOF. Browser playback latency is separate.

releaseArtifactEvidence: The accompanying dsh-jingshen-0.4.3-verification.json records hashes, sizes and the Linux rc.5 installation and browser runs for the distributed package.
limits: The authenticated checks synthesized an audition and six demo narration clips. Browser streaming, hangup and barge-in used a controlled upstream in a real rc.5 browser session.
The account balance, invoiced amount, hardware microphone-to-speaker latency and listening quality on other devices were not measured.
This release adds no new verification of Electron, other operating systems, or long-term model learning.
